title: fix(spec): one reader decides whether an external object's owner is provable, and record sharing and lint both read it
body:

_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiBU4VHoPDw4wUW5UW7aprCx)_

Fixes #27661

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

**Fable review owed.** This PR touches `packages/spec/src/**` and carries `Clause-②: yes`; it was developed on Opus while the Fable quota is out, and it does not land until a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` contract review record with a PASS verdict is on its current head.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：「外部对象的 owner 能否从声明的元数据证明」原来有三份判定（spec 的 `resolveInjectedColumnProvenance`、plugin-sharing 的 `hasPhantomOwnerAnchor`、lint 的 `hasUnprovableOwnerAnchor` 加 `columnMapTargets`）。现在 spec 新增一个导出 `isOwnerAnchorUnprovable`（provenance 判定 + `external.columnMap` 映到 `owner_id` 这一臂）和它用的 `externalColumnMapTargets`，plugin-sharing 与 lint 都改成直接读它，删掉各自的 `columnMap` 读取和身份比较副本；spec 里 #7858 那一行收敛表按现状重写。
- **为什么改**：#27425 只在 plugin-sharing 里加了 `columnMap` 分支，spec 的 helper 不认、收敛表也没记；下一个按收敛表对齐 helper 的消费方会悄悄放宽或收窄这类对象。
- **风险与回滚**：`resolveInjectedColumnProvenance` 本身不动（lint 写规则靠它区分「只映射未声明」）。已注册对象上读/写范围、共享拒绝和 lint 结论都不变；两处只在手搓文档上才会动的边角读法写在 Acceptance notes，两边都 fail closed。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column-provenance.ts`（新增的两个函数与收敛表 #7858 行）；`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/federated-phantom-anchors.ts`（`hasPhantomOwnerAnchor` 变成一行）；`packages/lint/src/validate-external-owner-sharing.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run src/external-owner-anchor-sql-read.test.ts src/federated-phantom-owner-scoping.test.ts`，预期全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（合约复审 PASS 之后）。

## What changes

- **`packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column-provenance.ts`** gains two exports on `@objectstack/spec/data`:
  - `externalColumnMapTargets(def, field)`: does `external.columnMap` (remote column to local field) map some remote column onto `field`? Tolerant of un-parsed records; a non-object `external` or `columnMap` answers `false`.
  - `isOwnerAnchorUnprovable(def)`: `true` exactly when `resolveInjectedColumnProvenance(def, 'owner_id') === 'injected-unprovisioned'` and `externalColumnMapTargets(def, 'owner_id')` is `false`. The one reader of "is an owner provable from declared metadata".
  - `resolveInjectedColumnProvenance` is unchanged, on purpose: a `columnMap` entry does not change who wrote the `owner_id` field, and lint's `security-external-owner-unmapped` needs that distinction (on a plugin driver the map is not applied, so only a declared field lets a member write). Folding the arm into the provenance verdict would have dropped that rule's mapped-but-undeclared findings. The new function's doc says so.
  - The convergence map's #7858 row now reads the head: plugin-sharing converges on `isOwnerAnchorUnprovable` (provenance plus the `columnMap` arm), and lint reads the same function.
- **`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/federated-phantom-anchors.ts`**: `hasPhantomOwnerAnchor(schema)` returns `isOwnerAnchorUnprovable(schema)`. The module's own `readFieldDef`, `equalsShippedDef`, `isFederatedObject` and `mapsRemoteColumnOntoOwner` copies are deleted (none was exported from the package entry; `git grep` finds no other importer), and the module doc's convergence paragraph is rewritten. `sharing-service.ts` is untouched.
- **`packages/lint/src/validate-external-owner-sharing.ts`**: `hasUnprovableOwnerAnchor(obj)` returns `isOwnerAnchorUnprovable(obj)`; the private `columnMapTargets` is replaced by `externalColumnMapTargets` in `externalOwnershipGap`. Messages and hints are untouched.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/vitest.config.ts`: the `metadata-core` alias comment no longer says the guard compares against `OWNER_FIELD_DEF` (only the scoping test's fixture imports it now).
- `packages/spec/api-surface/data.json` and `export-origins/data.json` regenerated (two new names each).
- Changeset `.changeset/27661-owner-anchor-one-reader.md`: patch on `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`, `@objectstack/lint`.

## Tests

On the final head `e402956d` (`fe45a398` plus the merge of `origin/main` `79d78b4e`), heavy runs under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 754 passed (754), Tests 22410 passed, 1 todo (22411); exit 0. Taken on `fe45a398`; the merge brought no change to `packages/spec/src/data/`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/injected-system-column-provenance.test.ts`: 10 passed, 4 of them new (the unprovable verdict in both document stages and both `fields` shapes; the `columnMap` arm with provenance staying `injected-unprovisioned`; declared, local and owner-less tiers; `columnMap` read as values only, tolerant of bad shapes).
- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing` `vitest run`: Test Files 58 passed (58), Tests 1290 passed (1290), on `e402956d`. The federated phantom-scoping suites and `external-owner-anchor-sql-read.test.ts` are unchanged and green.
- `packages/lint` `vitest run`: Test Files 178 passed (178), Tests 7623 passed (7623), on `e402956d`. `validate-external-owner-sharing.test.ts` is unchanged and green, so the rule's findings and hints keep their bytes.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-core test` (the producer's provenance matrix, through the re-export): Test Files 21 passed (21), Tests 873 passed (873).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing typecheck`: exit 0.

<details><summary>Ablation: both consumers really read the spec reader</summary>

Committed head first; the mutation deletes the `columnMap` guard line from `isOwnerAnchorUnprovable` in `packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column-provenance.ts` (`grep -c` of the guard line: 0 mutated, 1 restored, as at `HEAD`), then `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, because plugin-sharing and lint resolve `@objectstack/spec/data` through `dist/`.

- Mutant: plugin-sharing `external-owner-anchor-sql-read.test.ts` + `federated-phantom-owner-scoping.test.ts` 3 failed of 55 (the `columnMap` to `owner_id` arms: "own rows only"); lint `validate-external-owner-sharing.test.ts` + `validate-security-posture.test.ts` 1 failed of 202 ("keeps the private recommendation where the owner is provable").
- Restored with `git checkout HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` empty, spec rebuilt: 55 of 55 and 202 of 202 pass.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Edge move (a), unreachable at runtime.** A hand-built federated document with no `owner_id` key at all, on an `ownership: 'user'` object, used to answer `false` in plugin-sharing (its copy needed the key present) and now answers `true` (the spec treats a pre-injection document as carrying the injected anchor, as lint already did). Every `hasPhantomOwnerAnchor` caller in `sharing-service.ts` either checks `hasOwnerField(schema)` first (`buildReadFilter`, `buildWriteFilter`, `inertGrantReason`) or is the verdict-free write-deny diagnostic, and the registry always injects `owner_id` on such an object, so no registered schema reaches it.
- **Edge move (b), fails closed both ways.** An external object whose tier withholds `owner_id` (`ownership: 'none' | 'org' | 'business_unit'`, `systemFields: false`) but which declares a field byte-identical to `OWNER_FIELD_DEF` used to read as phantom in plugin-sharing (deny-all below `org`) and now reads as the author's field (the spec's existing rule: with no injected definition, any declaration is the author's), so ordinary owner scoping applies. On a remote that lacks the column that predicate matches no row. Agreed with the epic PM before the edit.
- Non-object `external` values (rejected by Zod, so only on un-parsed lint input): lint's `hasUnprovableOwnerAnchor` used to answer `false` for them and now follows the spec's `external != null` storage predicate, as plugin-sharing already did.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/federated-phantom-share-grant.dogfood.test.ts` L251-L256 still describes `hasPhantomOwnerAnchor` as hand-rolled. It is a historical test comment outside this card's file surface; noted, not filed (`carrier: none`).
- Serial constraint from the claim: #27662 edits plugin-sharing's write-deny diagnostic in `sharing-service.ts`; this PR does not touch that file, so the two do not overlap.

## Verification

Local gates on `e402956d`, every exit code written to a file before any pipe. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 86 families (the same 86 before and after the merge), every one was run after a full `pnpm build`:

- 86 exit 0, among them spec `check:api-surface` ("public API surface + factory signatures unchanged"), `check:export-origins` ("5651 exports across 19 entry points resolve exactly as recorded"), `check:docs` ("232 generated files in sync"), `check:authorable-surface`, `check:llms-txt`, `check:generated`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:i18n`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` and the `--self-test` batteries.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: "86 derived, 86 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` after the merge and a spec rebuild: all 14 artifacts up to date. Before the merge it found `api-surface/` and `export-origins/` stale (the two new names), regenerated with `gen:api-surface` and `gen:export-origins`.
- `origin/main` merged once, as `e402956d`, via `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` (main had not moved either regenerated artifact).
- The full battery (`pnpm lint`, Test Core shards, the UI jobs) is CI's and was not re-run locally. No dogfood battery: no `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (The new functions are document derivations beside the existing provenance derivation, tolerant of un-parsed input like the rest of the module.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the repo's own Chinese reader section).
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
